page.layout: One printed page, single column of text, with faint show-through from the reverse page in the background (ignored). No marginal notes. Signature mark at the foot left.

p.i: Venerandis, Pietate, Virtute, Eruditione & Doctrinâ Conspicuis Viris.

main_text.head: Dn. DAVIDI JENNERO, Ecclesiæ, quæ Christo in Wyl colligitur, Pastori fidelissimo, Ferventissimo, Dn. Agnato suo nunquàm non honorando, devenerando.
Dn. JACOBO DÜNCKIO, Pastori coetus Christiani in Waldringen/ laboriosissimo, vigilantissimo, Avunculo suo jugiter deamando, colendo.
Dn. ABRAHAMO BAURENKÖNG, Pastori & Eloquiorum Dei Præconi in Bol-lingen, facundissimô, acutissimo, Amitino suo omni honore ac amore afficiundo.
Dn. JACOBO BIZIO, V. D. M. Ludi-Magistro olim sextæ Classis, Dn. Cognato suo nunquàm non colendo, amando.
Dn. DANIELI DICK, Juveni Virtutis ac Pietatis Amantissimo, artis pictoriæ peritissimo, Amicorum suorum Optumo ad tumulum usq; diligendo.

p.i: Hasce Theses in Humillimæ Observantiæ Testeram Dat, Dicat & Consecrat.

page.notes: Show-through from the reverse page is faint and was ignored. Some letters in the Greek/Hebrew-style initials ("Wyl", "Waldringen") are as printed; the Hebrew-looking glyph in "Wyl" and the Greek-looking mark in "Ut &" are rendered as best read. Doubtful readings: "Wyl" may be a Hebrew or symbol abbreviation.
